join hortbot 999 foobar 1
join hortbot 999 otherchan 10
join hortbot 999 under_score 11


# GET
handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add test = (_VARS_what_GET_foobar_)
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] =

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!var set what Hello there.
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] = Hello there.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add test = (_VARS_what_GET_)
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] = Hello there.


# Cross channel GET
handle hortbot otherchan/10 otherchan/10 :!var set othervar Hi from otherchan!
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add test = (_VARS_othervar_GET_OtherChan_)
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] = Hi from otherchan!

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add test = (_VARS_nope_GET_OtherChan_)
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] =

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add test = (_VARS_othervar_GET_doesntexist_)
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] =


handle hortbot under_score/11 under_score/11 :!var set othervar Hi from under_score!
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add test = (_VARS_othervar_GET_Under_Score_)
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] = Hi from under_score!


# SET
handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add test (_VARS_what_SET_this is a test_) == (_VARS_what_GET_foobar_)
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] this is a test == this is a test


# INCREMENT
handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add rip Foobar has died (_VARS_game_INCREMENT_1_) times in game!
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!rip
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Foobar has died 1 times in game!

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!rip
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Foobar has died 2 times in game!


# DECREMENT
handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add unrip Foobar has died (_VARS_game_DECREMENT_1_) times in game!
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!unrip
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Foobar has died 1 times in game!


# Errors
handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add test = (_VARS__)
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] = (error)

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add test = (_VARS_huh_)
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] = (error)

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add test = (_VARS_huh__)
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] = (error)

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add test = (_VARS_huh_GET__)
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] = (error)

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add test = (_VARS_huh_WOT_)
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] = (error)

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add test = (_VARS_game_INCREMENT__)
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] = (error)

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add test = (_VARS_game_INCREMENT_ok_)
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] = (error)

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add test = (_VARS_what_INCREMENT_1_)
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!test
send hortbot #foobar [HB] = (error)
